exact.backward_failure: For -1/(3*beta)<lambda<0 every Delta_s(lambda)<0 and the quadratic zeros are nonreal; generic backward Stieltjes-cone invariance is false
exact.open_handoff: A backward argument from a de Bruijn real-zero time must use Xi/Phi-specific all-order rigidity or a uniform no-escape theorem, not generic invariance of the Stieltjes moment cone
exact.rank_one_boundary: At H(z)=(1+beta*z)^m, a_n=m*beta^(n+1) and every shifted 2x2 Stieltjes minor Delta_s=a_s*a_(s+2)-a_(s+1)^2 vanishes

proof_boundary: This artifact proves the radial log-derivative and Edrei-moment heat hierarchies and gives an exact LP+ polynomial countermodel to generic backward Stieltjes-cone invariance. It does not prove an Xi/Phi-specific invariant, all-order Stieltjes positivity at lambda zero, PF-infinity, Jensen hyperbolicity for zeta, RH, or Lambda<=0.

rows.claim: The squared-variable Phi transform obeys the radial heat equation.
rows.proof_boundary: This is an evolution identity, not a zero-location statement.

rows.claim: Its logarithmic derivative obeys a closed radial Burgers equation.
rows.proof_boundary: The nonlinear PDE does not preserve the desired cone backward by itself.

rows.claim: Coefficient extraction gives a closed hierarchy for the exact Edrei moments a_n=p_(n+1).
rows.proof_boundary: All shifts are coupled through a_(n+1) and the convolution term.

rows.claim: The ordinary moment generating series obeys an equivalent nonlinear PDE.
rows.proof_boundary: Formal equivalence only; it does not provide a positive representing measure.

rows.claim: A repeated type-I factor is a rank-one Stieltjes boundary point at every shift.
rows.formula: At H(z)=(1+beta*z)^m, a_n=m*beta^(n+1) and every shifted 2x2 Stieltjes minor Delta_s=a_s*a_(s+2)-a_(s+1)^2 vanishes
rows.proof_boundary: The multiplicity m is an integer for an entire LP+ factor.

rows.claim: Every shifted 2x2 Stieltjes wall points strictly into the cone under forward heat when m>=2.
rows.proof_boundary: The same sign means immediate exit under backward heat.

rows.claim: The radial heat orbit of a double negative zero is an explicit quadratic.
rows.proof_boundary: A finite LP+ model, not the Xi function.

rows.claim: The quadratic discriminant changes sign exactly at the repeated-zero boundary.
rows.proof_boundary: Shows the local Newman-type collision mechanism exactly.

rows.claim: Every shifted 2x2 Edrei/Stieltjes minor has the same crossing sign.
rows.proof_boundary: Rejects rescue by moving to a different finite shift.

rows.claim: The Stieltjes moment cone is not generically invariant under backward radial heat.
rows.formula: For -1/(3*beta)<lambda<0 every Delta_s(lambda)<0 and the quadratic zeros are nonreal; generic backward Stieltjes-cone invariance is false
rows.proof_boundary: Does not exclude a stronger Xi/Phi-specific invariant.

rows.claim: The surviving dynamical route needs a uniform Xi/Phi rigidity mechanism preventing an all-order boundary escape.
rows.formula: A backward argument from a de Bruijn real-zero time must use Xi/Phi-specific all-order rigidity or a uniform no-escape theorem, not generic invariance of the Stieltjes moment cone
rows.proof_boundary: No such all-order Xi/Phi theorem is proved here.

status: exact heat-flow lemma, exact backward-invariance countermodel, and open Xi/Phi handoff
